# RachnaSutra AI

> Open-source UI/UX design engineering and audit agent. 13 portable Agent Skills (led by RachnaSutra Prime) plus a keyless, deterministic CLI for accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA oriented), responsive design, design-system, content and performance review of front-end source code. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI using the IDE's own model; no extra API key. Outputs JSON, Markdown, HTML and SARIF. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0. Repository: https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/rachnasutra

## Skills
- [rachnasutra-prime](skills/rachnasutra-prime/SKILL.md): orchestrator
- [rachnasutra-access](skills/rachnasutra-access/SKILL.md): WCAG 2.2 AA review
- [rachnasutra-adapt](skills/rachnasutra-adapt/SKILL.md): responsive, mobile, TV
- [rachnasutra-tokens](skills/rachnasutra-tokens/SKILL.md): design tokens
- [rachnasutra-audit](skills/rachnasutra-audit/SKILL.md): full ranked audit
- [rachnasutra-verify](skills/rachnasutra-verify/SKILL.md): fix verification
- Also: vision, flow, canvas, motion, speed, content, convert

## Key facts
- Install skills: `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/rachnasutra skills install --host <claude|cursor|codex|copilot|gemini> --target .`
- Audit: `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/rachnasutra audit . --json`
- CI gate: `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/rachnasutra ci .` (exit 1 on confirmed high or critical findings)
- Read-only by default; no network, telemetry or model calls from the CLI; secrets redacted in reports.
- Static analysis only in 0.1.0. Browser, screenshot, axe and Lighthouse audits are not available yet and exit with code 3.
- Not a WCAG, ADA or other conformance certification. No quality score is produced.
- 22 automated tests pass; sample runs and raw outputs are in documents/rachnasutra/evidence/.
